system.description:
You conjure a funnel cloud in the midst of your enemies.

Choose a point within 10 spaces. Creatures within a 5-space-radius of that point take 1 Damage and must make an opposed Reflexes or be swept off their feet into the funnel cloud.

Creatures that succeed on the Reflexes check must choose a point outside the radius of the cloud that they can travel to. They dash or are flung to this point. If no such point exists, they automatically fail.

Creatures captured by the funnel cloud cannot move and are Stunned. Their Defense increases by +1, as spinning in the funnel cloud makes them harder to hit.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.

Alternatively, you may increase the Damage by +1 per extra success.

You may move the cloud 5 spaces at the start of your turn, provided that it has any duration remaining.

When the spell ends, any creatures captured by the cloud immediately fall Prone.
